issue.title: Fix state filter pills rendering badges that get clipped

labels.name: area:UI
labels.description: Related to UI/UX. For Frontend Developers.

repository.name: airflow
repository.description: Apache Airflow - A platform to programmatically author, schedule, and monitor workflows

issue.body:
## Description

State-bearing select filters (Last run state, Run state, Task state, HITL response, Run type) render their selected value as a `StateBadge`. #72459 fixed the badge being clipped in the select trigger; this PR fixes the remaining half of #72283: **the collapsed filter pills**.

`FilterPill` is a fixed-height (`h="9"`) row, and `SelectFilter` passed the rich label node straight through as the pill's display value, so the badge is still cut off top and bottom inside the pill.

This PR adds an optional plain-text `pillLabel` to select filter options:

- `components/FilterBar/types.ts` / `filters/SelectFilter.tsx`: when an option provides `pillLabel`, the collapsed pill renders it instead of the rich label. The trigger is untouched and keeps the badge behavior from #72459.
- `constants/filterConfigs.tsx`: sets `pillLabel: translate(...)` on the state-bearing option groups.

Before and after, with the Dags list filtered on `last_dag_run_state=failed`:

| Before (badge clipped in the fixed-height pill) | After (plain text) |
| --- | --- |
| ![before pill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Java123456com/airflow/pr-72574-assets/files/screenshots/before/pill.png) | ![after pill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Java123456com/airflow/pr-72574-assets/files/screenshots/after/pill.png) |
| ![before full](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Java123456com/airflow/pr-72574-assets/files/screenshots/before/full.png) | ![after full](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Java123456com/airflow/pr-72574-assets/files/screenshots/after/full.png) |

## Related Issue

Closes #72283

## How was this patch tested?

- New regression test in `DagsFilters.test.tsx`: the pill for `last_dag_run_state=failed` shows the plain-text state label and contains no `state-badge`, while the dropdown options still render badges.
- `vitest run src/components/FilterBar src/pages/DagsList/DagsFilters` — all tests pass.
- `tsc` and eslint clean; verified visually on the dev server (screenshots above).
